Title: 3 Habits Behind Heat Syncope (Not Just "Feeling Hot")

Description:
Feel dizzy or faint after standing in the heat too long? That's heat syncope - your body sends extra blood to your skin to cool down, pulling blood flow away from your brain, and sweating makes it worse. Standing up too fast, staying in direct sun without breaks, and pushing through warning signs like lightheadedness all raise your risk.

Pause before you stand, take shade breaks every 20-30 minutes, and if the warning signs hit, sit or lie down and raise your legs right away.
